training_selection: all ten predeclared training splits pooled; no holdout rows

task.target: experimental percentage estimate for next individually graded same-subject quiz/test/exam
task.sleep: accessible asleep union yesterday noon to min(now,today noon)
task.steps: previous completed local calendar day total
task.exercise_minutes: previous completed local calendar day Apple Exercise total
task.resting_heart_rate: latest finite positive sample within previous72 elapsed hours, timestamp retained
task.study_minutes: previous completed local calendar day outside-class study for selected subject, including academic screen use
task.screen_time_minutes: previous completed local calendar day recreational non-study active screen time, simultaneous devices counted once
task.previous_score: most recent prior individual assessment in SAME subject, 1–90 local days old, earned/max*100
task.horizon_effect: not learned; constant mean relationship across permitted horizons assumed

missing_policy: abstain on missing required input; never substitute zero
metadata_gate: dated yesterday reports, selected/previous/study subject identity, next assessment 1–7 days, latest prior 1–90 days, valid percent scale; retain current HealthKit freshness
input_transforms: none except StandardScaler; nonlinear functions belong only to synthetic target generation
what_if: override same captured source-period totals; no live-state writes or causal grade claim
